title: High Engagement Player Fraction
scenario: Find the fraction of players who have played more than the average number of total games across all players. Return 'fraction'.
tableSchema: activity (player_id INT, device_id INT, event_date DATE, games_played INT)
hint: Calculate total games per player first, then compute the ratio against the global average.
correctQuery: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN total_games > avg_games THEN 1 END)::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) AS fraction FROM (SELECT player_id, SUM(games_played) AS total_games FROM activity GROUP BY player_id) t1, (SELECT AVG(total_games) AS avg_games FROM (SELECT SUM(games_played) AS total_games FROM activity GROUP BY player_id) t2) t3;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE activity (player_id INT, device_id INT, event_date DATE, games_played INT); INSERT INTO activity VALUES (1, 1, '2026-01-01', 10), (2, 1, '2026-01-01', 2);
